purpose: Teach: といふ/劼/氣/ゎ/榮/佛/に当たりまして/翁

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、古文の「といふ」、つまり「という」の用法研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered the usage of classical 「といふ」—that is, 「という」—in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Genuinely interested in the student's work. Steady pacing, clear articulation. The cadence of a teacher confirming something she already knows, drawing the student out.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、漢字の劼、つまり「劼勉」の用法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I researched the usage of the character 劼, or 「劼勉」, in my paper.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive response. Direct eye contact implied. Clear, measured delivery. A student showing care in answering a teacher's question. No rush.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 旧字「氣」、つまり気の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also examined the old character form 「氣」—that is, the character for 気—in your literary research, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently probing. Slight pause before the clarification, as if recalling. Calm teacher's voice, neither testing nor lecturing. Notes something noteworthy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、小書きのゎ、つまり仮名の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I covered the history of the small kana ゎ, or how kana script developed, in my paper.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. Slightly more confident than before. The student settling into the conversation. Steady breath, no hesitation. Professional but genuine.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 旧字「榮」、つまり栄華の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the old character form 「榮」—that is, 栄華—you researched that in your literary work as well, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly impressed. A subtle smile in the voice. Teacher drawing connections, building momentum. Warm but observant. The cadence of someone who notices the pattern.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、旧字「佛」、つまり仏教史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I researched the history of Buddhism through the old character form 「佛」 in my paper.
lines.style: Confident, assured delivery now. The student has found her rhythm. Voice opens slightly. Still respectful, but with growing ease. The breath flows naturally.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 研究発表に当たりまして、序文の書き方を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: In preparing for your presentation, you also covered how to write an introduction in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Encouraging, almost gentle. Teacher drawing toward a close. Reflective tone, validating the scope of the student's work. Steady, supportive cadence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、隠居した翁、つまり老翁の民俗誌を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined the folklore surrounding the retired old man, or 老翁, in my paper.
lines.style: Warm closing response. The student finishing strong, relaxed but attentive. Clear articulation with a subtle sense of completion. Respectful and genuine to the end.
